photos.title: Streets of houses in Carolina Forest, NOAA aerial, January 2026
photos.what: Two streets of two-story houses with gray roofs, short driveways and small back yards, several fenced, ending in a cul-de-sac, with ponds and a strip of pine woods to the left, in Carolina Forest outside city limits, seen from above on January 12, 2026. Lawns are brown in January. Cars are too small to read; no person can be recognized.
photos.caption: Houses on streets in Carolina Forest, outside city limits, seen from above.
photos.alt: Rows of two-story houses with gray roofs and short driveways along curving streets and a cul-de-sac, beside ponds and pine woods, seen from above
photos.author: NOAA National Geodetic Survey
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: NOAA National Geodetic Survey (NGS), Remote Sensing Division, Emergency Response Imagery, 2026 pre-event coastal collection, East Coast group EC2601a, flown 2026-01-12. One map tile, EC2601a_OB_N_C0785315w334545n.tif (4707 x 4707 px, WGS 84, 2.698e-6 degrees a pixel, top left -78.8875987, 33.7625987), the copy downloaded 2026-11-02 from the public S3 bucket noaa-eri-pds by the writer of /invest/run-the-numbers/ (scratchpad wf2/invest-run-the-numbers/dl). This frame (pixels 1700-2780 x 3420-4230) is a different part of the tile from the photos on /invest/rent-prices/ (2450-4050 x 1550-2750) and /invest/run-the-numbers/ (2800-4400 x 2900-4100).

photos.subject_check: Looked at full size (1200 x 900) by the fixer on 2026-11-02. All four frame corners and the center fall inside the Census place outline of Carolina Forest (a census-designated place, not a town) in Blog-Brain tools/geo/grand-strand-v2.json (TIGER/Line 2026). The caption names no neighborhood, street or house. No person, plate, sign or house number is readable.
